questions.question: What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series? 34, 46, 61, 79, 100, ?
questions.questionHtml:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

34, 46, 61, 79, 100, ?
questions.solution:
Series: 34, 46, 61, 79, 100, ?

Difference:

46 − 34 = 12
61 − 46 = 15
79 − 61 = 18
100 − 79 = 21

The difference is increasing by 3 each time:

12, 15, 18, 21, 24

So, 100 + 24 = 124

Therefore, the missing number is 124.

questions.question: What was the day of the week on 10 June 2011?
questions.questionHtml: What was the day of the week on 10 June 2011?
questions.solution:
Solution using Month Code and Year Code:

Formula:
Day Code = Date + Month Code + Year Code + Century Code

For 10 June 2011:

Date = 10
Month Code for June = 4
Year Code for 2011 = 11 + floor(11/4) = 11 + 2 = 13
Century Code for 2000s = 6

Now,
Day Code = 10 + 4 + 13 + 6
Day Code = 33

Now divide by 7:
33 ÷ 7 = remainder 5

Day codes:
0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, 2 = Tuesday, 3 = Wednesday, 4 = Thursday, 5 = Friday, 6 = Saturday

So, remainder 5 = Friday.

Therefore, 10 June 2011 was Friday.

questions.questionHtml:
Decide which course of action logically follows.

Statement:
The number of road accidents in the city has increased significantly due to poor visibility during heavy fog.

Courses of Action:
I. Install proper street lighting and warning signboards immediately.
II. Encourage people to drive at higher speeds to reduce travel time.
questions.solution:
Course I follows because proper street lighting and warning signboards can improve visibility and reduce accidents during heavy fog.

Course II does not follow because driving at higher speeds in fog is dangerous and can increase accidents.

So, only Course of Action I logically follows.

questions.question: This question is based on the following words: COP, TIK, ANY, CAN, OWN If in each of the words, each letter is changed to the next letter in the English alphabetical order, how many words thus formed will have no vowel?
questions.questionHtml:
This question is based on the following words:

COP, TIK, ANY, CAN, OWN

If in each of the words, each letter is changed to the next letter in the English alphabetical order, how many words thus formed will have no vowel?
questions.solution:
Given words: COP, TIK, ANY, CAN, OWN

After changing each letter to the next letter:

COP → DPQ
TIK → UJL
ANY → BOZ
CAN → DBO
OWN → PXO

Now check vowels: A, E, I, O, U

DPQ → No vowel
UJL → Has U
BOZ → Has O
DBO → Has O
PXO → Has O

So, only one word has no vowel.

Correct answer = One.

questions.question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair does NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
questions.questionHtml:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair does NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
questions.solution:
Answer: (d) KQ - PM

Solution:
In the first three pairs, the pattern is:

First letter +5
Second letter -5

YE → DZ
Y + 5 = D, E - 5 = Z

NW → SR
N + 5 = S, W - 5 = R

IM → NH
I + 5 = N, M - 5 = H

But in KQ → PM:
K + 5 = P, Q - 5 = L, not M

So, KQ - PM does not belong to the group.

questions.question: In a row of students, Amit is 20th from the left end and Ravi is 40th from the right end. If they interchange their positions, Amit becomes 35th from the left end. What is the total number of students in the row?
questions.questionHtml: In a row of students, Amit is 20th from the left end and Ravi is 40th from the right end. If they interchange their positions, Amit becomes 35th from the left end. What is the total number of students in the row?
questions.solution:
Total students = Left position + Right position − 1
= 35 + 40 – 1 = 74

So, the total number of students in the row is 74.
